name: Pendant of Proof against Curses
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Slot neck; Price 6,000 gp; Weight 0.5 lbs

DESCRIPTION

This pendant is set with a white pearl, though specs of black dust appear to shift within.

This necklace protects its wearer against curses and grants a boon against creatures who use them. While wearing the pendant you gain a +2 bonus on saves against spells with the curse or evil descriptors.While wearing the pendant if you fail a save against a spell with the curse or evil descriptor you may shatter the pendant as an immediate action and be unaffected by the spell, if you do, you gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls against the caster of the spell until the end of your next turn. Using the pendant in this way permanently destroys it.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells magic weapon, protection from evil; Price 3,000 gp
